title: thlaspi hastulatum
intro: Thlaspi hastulatum, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it a valuable treatment for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
